description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 fuzzpro: every window of a protein sequence that matches a PROSITE-like pattern: amino-acid letters (case-insensitive; B = D or N, Z = E or Q, J = I or L; x = any residue), classes [ILV], exclusions {P} (plain letters only: B, Z, J, X inside [] or {} are rejected as in the binary), repeats x(3), length ranges x(2,4) (every matching window length is reported; (0,n) makes the element optional), '-' separators, the anchors '<' (N terminus) and '>' (C terminus), a terminating '.'; e.g. [DE](2)HS{P}x(2)Px(2,4)C. The search is exact (fuzzpro has no mismatch option). A start-anchored pattern with a range reports only its longest match (the binary's regular-expression search class); a single trailing stop '*' is not part of the sequence. Positions are 0-based; hits are ordered by position, then length. Verified against fuzzpro 6.6.0 on 900 random patterns (letters, classes, exclusions, repeats, ranges, anchors; sequences with X, B, Z, U, J, O, * and lower case). For nucleotide patterns see find_pattern_hits (fuzznuc), for a translated search fuzztran.

sequence.description: Protein sequence (letters; a trailing * is dropped).
